I am 70 years old, been on this land in Quzhou for 50 years. My middle school teacher taught me to read and figure numbers, so I listen when the agri-station people come, but mostly I trust what my own hands have learned and what I see on my neighbors' fields.

Cotton is what I plant. 5 mu, all cotton, same as last year and the year before. My wife and I work it ourselves, the boy helps at picking time when he comes back from the city.

For seed, I buy the Bt cotton — 抗虫棉. Everyone around here uses it now. The old varieties, the bollworm eats you alive and you spray and spray. With Bt seed I spray maybe 4, 5 times for aphids and mirids and spider mites, that's enough. Without it, 10 times, 12 times, and still lose bolls.

Fertilizer — cotton eats a lot, especially nitrogen, and it wants potassium too or the bolls won't fill. Before planting I plough the land and put down compound fertilizer, 一袋 (50 jin, that's 25 kg) of 15-15-15 per mu as base, so that gives me about 7.5 kg of each per mu from the base. Then at squaring and flowering I topdress urea, two times, maybe 15 kg urea each time per mu — that's another 14 kg nitrogen or so. I also add some potassium sulfate at flowering, maybe 10 kg per mu, because my neighbor老王 did it two years ago and his bolls were fuller than mine. So altogether, about 22 kg N, 7-8 kg P, 13-14 kg K per mu. Better to put a little extra than have yellow leaves in August.

Water — I have a well, thank heaven. Cotton I water at planting (winter irrigation or spring if dry), then at budding, flowering, boll-filling. About 4 times in the season. If the sky gives rain I skip one.

Tillage — I plough deep before planting, turn in the stalks from last year. Rotary only is not enough for cotton, the roots need to go deep.

Yield — a good year I get 250 kg of seed cotton per mu, bad year 200. I plan for 240.
